en.headline: Pipe burst cuts water to parts of Eastern district after Shau Kei Wan works
en.dek: Supply was suspended from 11am in Sai Wan Ho, Shau Kei Wan, Aldrich Bay and nearby areas; authorities aim to restore it before midnight. An elderly care-home resident was injured.
body: A fresh-water pipe burst on Shau Kei Wan Road on Tuesday morning during roadside works, flooding the carriageway and cutting supply to several areas of Eastern district from 11am.

The Water Supplies Department said on its website that the suspension affected Sai Wan Ho, Shau Kei Wan, Aldrich Bay and the stretch from A Kung Ngam Road to Island Garden. Eastern district councillor Wong Chi-chueng told the South China Morning Post the rupture was outside 312 Shau Kei Wan Road and was suspected to have been caused by construction work carried out by a Highways Department contractor.

Police said they received a report near 11am that a care home at 312-322 Shau Kei Wan Road had been affected. An elderly female resident suffered a leg injury when a window was shattered by the spray; she was conscious and taken to Eastern Hospital. Videos showed a high jet of muddy water shooting from the worksite.
Authorities were conducting emergency repairs and expected to restore supply before midnight. Residents and businesses in the affected zones were left without fresh water while the works continued.

zh.headline: 笮箕灣道路工程爆水管 東區部分地區停水至午夜前
zh.dek: 水務署自上午11時起暫停西灣河、笮箕灣、愛秩序灣及阿公岩道至香島一帶食水供應，目標午夜前恢復。安老院舍一名院友腳傷。
body: 周二早上，笮箕灣道一處道路工程期間爆水管，大量泥水湧出路面，並自上午11時起切斷東區多個地區的食水供應。
水務署在網頁表示，停水範圍包括西灣河、笮箕灣、愛秩序灣及阿公岩道至香島一帶。東區區議員黃志昌向《南華早報》表示，爆水管位置在笮箕灣道312號外，懷疑由路政署承辦商的工程引起。
警方表示，上午近11時接獲報案，指笮箕灣道312至322號一間安老院舍受影響，一名年長女院友因玻璃窗爆裂而腳部受傷，清醒送往東區醫院。現場影片顯示數米高的黃泥水柱從地盤噴出。
當局正進行緊急搶修，預計午夜前恢復供水。受影響地區的居民及商戶暫時沒有食水供應。
